meta.title: About us | ConAI
meta.description: AI isn't a replacement for people — it's a tool. ConAI's story, mission and vision, plus answers to common questions.

about.title: AI isn't a replacement for people. It's a tool.

blocks.text: ConAI was founded in 2026 on a simple conviction: artificial intelligence isn't a replacement for people but a tool that lets them work more efficiently. We want to make modern AI genuinely useful to companies — saving time and removing pointless manual work.

Our mission isn't to change how your company works. We want to understand your processes and find the places where AI removes unnecessary work. Routine and admin go to the machines — capacity for creativity, strategy and decision-making stays with people, where they're irreplaceable.

We believe companies will work with external AI specialists as naturally as they work with lawyers, accountants or marketing agencies today. Implementation is just the beginning — the real value comes from long-term optimization and staying on top of what's new.

about.statement: The future doesn't belong to companies that replace people with AI. It belongs to companies that combine what people and technology do best.

items.a: No. We see AI as a tool, not a replacement for people. It takes over repetitive, time-consuming and administrative work so your team can focus on creativity, strategy, relationships and decisions.

Yes. For sensitive work we deploy models locally on your hardware, so your files never leave the building. For cloud solutions we use private processing — your data is never used to train public models.

items.q: Do I need technical skills or an IT department?
items.a: No. We handle setup, integration and maintenance. You work with simple interfaces and approvals — email-level skills are enough.

items.q: How fast can we launch something?
items.a: A pilot automation is typically live within a few weeks. Larger and local deployments take longer — the exact timeline comes out of the joint plan.
Price follows scope and complexity, not the tools used. The pricing page shows indicative starting points; you get an exact number after the free audit.

items.q: Will I have to change how my company operates?
items.a: No. We start from your existing processes and look for places where AI removes manual work or speeds up what you already do. The technology adapts to your company, not the other way around.

items.q: What happens after the solution is deployed?
items.a: Implementation is just the start. We stay on as a long-term partner: optimizing systems, watching developments and spotting new opportunities.
